security_rif_006_answer:
Triggers: Board determination to eliminate or reduce bargaining unit positions.
Notice: Board must notify and consult with the Association prior to a decision. Within 10 days of the determination, a list of affected impact areas and positions is sent. A 10-day notice is also required for eliminating extracurricular/stipend positions, with an opportunity for consultation before specific terminations.
Order & Seniority: Least senior educator in an impact area is laid off first.
Exemptions/Criteria: Seniority may be overridden if the least senior educator possesses superior qualifications and abilities (determined by teacher effectiveness, certification, training, advanced degrees, or experience for program needs; or experience, skills, management/interpersonal ability for extracurricular/differentials). Qualifications are evaluated in inverse order of seniority. Board decisions on qualifications are final unless arbitrary/capricious.
Recall: Laid-off educators retain recall rights in inverse layoff order within their impact area for up to 15 months or 10 days after notice of an available position.
security_rif_006_evidence:
3. Procedure – Notice
a) If the Board is contemplating the elimination of any bargaining unit positions, it (or its designee) will notify the Association. The Board (or its designee) will meet and consult with the Association prior to a decision to eliminate any bargaining unit positions.
b) Not later than 10 days after the Board determines that a reduction in the bargaining unit positions shall occur, it shall send to the Association a list of the affected impact areas and the positions to be eliminated.
c) The Board shall also give the Association a similar 10 days' notice of the elimination of both extra-curricular and stipend/differential positions. Before terminating a specific educator under this Paragraph, representatives of the Association will be given an opportunity to meet with the Superintendent or his representative to consult with and make recommendations concerning individual terminations.
4. Layoff
a) The least senior educator in an impact area shall be laid off except as subsequently modified hereafter: ... (i) The least senior educator has more qualifications and more ability than a more senior educator relative to the programs to be offered. ... (ii) The least senior educator holds a differential or extracurricular position that no educator in the impact area is both qualified and willing to fill.
b) Qualifications and abilities referred to in (i) above shall be determined by teacher effectiveness ratings, certification, training ... advanced degrees ... and experience...
c) Qualifications and abilities referred to in (ii) above shall be determined by any of the following: experience, skills, training, management ability, supervisory ability, interpersonal skills, motivational skills, organization, knowledge of the activity, and judgment.
d) The application of abilities and qualifications referred to in c above shall be determined by the Board and shall not be subject to review except for arbitrary or capricious action.
5. Recall ... Recall rights shall terminate at the end of 15 months after the educator goes off the payroll, or ten days after the educator receives notice of an available position, whichever occurs first. ... Recall shall be in the inverse order of layoff.
